notes.title: Demo update 0.9.3 patch notes
notes.notes:
Here it is, the last update of the year!

Bug fixes

 Fix first camp song not looping
 Fix incorrect collisions in spell shop
 Fix some sprites in spell shop being in front of the player when they should be behind
 Fix slime enemy animation issue

See you in 2024!

notes.title: Demo build 0.9.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It's been a while. The development team has been quite tied up with other commitments, making it a bit tricky to stay on top of our game dev duties. Despite the difficulties, work on SPELLRAIN hasn't stopped, and we've made quite a few changes since you last played, starting with the most important: our art rework.

We've heard feedback about visual elements not quite fitting together, so we've been working on a few art changes to make the game prettier overall.

General improvements

Completely reworked main menu
Remade grass and stone tiles
Remade camp sprites and animations
Remade all tree sprites
Remade slime animations
Remade health pickup sprite
Remade UI icons
Remade UI buttons
Remade shop tiles
Shop guiding fairy moves more naturally
Reorganized shop layout
Added better borders to map edges
Added shadows to important elements
Added a bunch of new props and tiles to level 2
Changed version naming


Balance

The Elite of Dragons boss now moves faster, deals more damage and has more HP
The Elite of Dragons boss now also spawns regular dragons and bomb enemies during the boss wave
The Elite of Dragons boss no longer spawns other enemies during the boss wave


Bug fixes

Fixed game configuration not saving properly
Fixed spell unlocking occasionally not unlocking anything even after spending money, again.
Fixed camp button occasionally not working after losing an exploration
Fixed crafted equipment not being saved


As you may have noticed, because of external factors, the pace of development hasn't been as swift as we'd like. Because of that, we've decided to extend our release date to sometime next year. We believe this will give us the time we need to ensure SPELLRAIN meets the standards you all deserve. Thanks for your understanding and see you all next year!

notes.title: Demo build 8.1 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello! We recently launched the demo of SPELLRAIN, and it became pretty clear it had some issues. When players informed us about these issues we immediately began working on fixing them as soon as we could. This update addresses most of the problems found.

Changelog
Bug fixes

Fixed gear appearing as if it was equipped in the armory UI even when it wasn't the case
Fixed improper formatting of the gear upgrade statue UI
Fixed shop fairy guide not disappearing during the tutorial
Fixed a glitch that caused the whole game to appear in slow motion when pressing TAB or ESC while dying
Fixed issue where dying during the tutorial allowed you to skip the entire tutorial
Fixed not being able to buy booster packs if you had exactly the amount of money required
Fixed windowed screen option not working as expected
Fixed reroll button in spell shop randomly adding cards that weren't unlocked yet
Possibly fixed frequent issue where you started a level without a spell to defend yourself with
Despite our best efforts we were unable to replicate this particular bug ourselves. However, this should be fixed now. If you still experience this bug please let us know.


Balance

Slightly increased material cost of crafting gear
Reduced amount of materials dropped by enemies


This is one of the many examples of why bigger dev teams have dedicated QA teams. Sadly, we do not have such luxury. That being said, we apologize to anyone who experienced these issues, and we assure you that we will be working hard to improve the game so that it meets our quality standards.
